description: Ask to be let into this library. No access is needed to ask. Returns a request id and a claim secret (shown once); the owner approves or denies; collect the outcome with library_access.

did.description: Who is asking, as a did.

name.description: A name the owner will recognise.

note.description: Why, in a sentence or two.

patron.description: Optional: who is asking ? {did, name, runtime}. Anonymous when absent.

name: library_request_access
